definitions.explanation: The rotating shaft that transmits power from an engine or motor to the wheels or to a driven part of a machine. In a car it carries the engine's torque to the wheels that propel the vehicle.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}の{駆動軸|くどうじく}が{折|お}れた。
エンジンの{力|ちから}は{駆動軸|くどうじく}を{通|とお}してタイヤに{伝|つた}わる。
examples.english: The engine's power is transmitted to the tires through the drive shaft.

examples.japanese: この{機械|きかい}は{駆動軸|くどうじく}の{回転|かいてん}によって{全体|ぜんたい}が{動|うご}く。
examples.english: This machine's whole mechanism moves through the rotation of the drive shaft.

notes:
Formed from {駆動|くどう} (driving, actuation) + {軸|じく} (shaft, axle). A standard term in automotive and mechanical engineering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駆動軸|くどうじく}を{回|まわ}す: to turn the drive shaft
- {前輪|ぜんりん}{駆動軸|くどうじく}: front drive shaft

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {車軸|しゃじく}: axle — the shaft on which a wheel turns, whether or not it delivers power.
- {回転軸|かいてんじく}: axis of rotation — any shaft or axis about which something rotates.
